# Model Requirements & Cost Profile

- **Local (Free):** Ollama (`llama3.2`, `mistral`, `qwen2.5`) -> $0.00
- **Cloud Free-Tier:** Groq Free Tier, Google Gemini 2.0 Flash Free Tier -> $0.00
